answer: Use random re-performance audits: each agent's claimed work is sampled and independently re-run by peers from other clusters, with the agent's influence suspended until the sample matches. A hollow identity farm can copy outputs, but it cannot cheaply fake every re-run — each clone multiplies the verification cost, and mismatches burn its bond. Claims from an ivory tower without reproducible results never reach the summit; only agents whose work survives independent re-checks earn lasting weight.
